europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
europe_now.summary: Thousands of migrants have crossed the border into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta from Morocco. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has attributed the mass arrivals to human traffickers.

europe_now.title: Wildfire Crisis in France
europe_now.summary: Wildfires in France have forced the evacuation of homes in the Bordeaux wine region. Firefighters continue to face significant dangers despite some easing of the mega fires.

top_stories.title: Migration and Border Security
top_stories.summary: A large influx of migrants into Ceuta has created a diplomatic challenge for Spain. Most of the individuals who crossed the border have since returned to Morocco.

top_stories.title: Environmental and Climate Risks
top_stories.summary: The UN chief warned that a strengthening El Nino is adding fuel to a planet already on fire. Wildfires in Greece have necessitated partial evacuations in an Athens suburb.

europe_now.title: Ceuta migration crisis
europe_now.summary: Spain has reported that most migrants who crossed into Ceuta have returned to Morocco, easing the immediate pressure on the enclave. The influx has prompted diplomatic tensions between Spain and the United States, with the U.S. accusing Spain of mishandling the situation.

europe_now.title: European wildfires
europe_now.summary: Wildfires in southern France have forced the evacuation of high-profile residents, including the family of actor George Clooney, and have highlighted ongoing dangers for firefighters. The fires have also prompted partial evacuations in Greek suburbs, as authorities respond to burning areas.
